chapters.title: The Surprising Power of Atomic Habits

sections.title: Section 1 of The Surprising Power of Atomic Habits

elements.text: The Surprising Power of Atomic Habits - Part 1

Habits are small, everyday choices that shape our identity and outcomes. Through repetition, they compound into powerful forces that determine success or failure. Tiny changes might appear trivial at first, but over time they rewrite who we are and what we can achieve. The lesson of atomic habits is that you don’t need massive action, you need consistent, intentional action.
